propositions: rebar must not use git stash operations in the tickets worktree because the stash stack is shared across all linked worktrees of a repository, allowing stash entries created in one worktree to be popped into another
a stash created on a different branch can be inadvertently applied into the tickets worktree, leaving the index in an unmerged state that blocks all subsequent ticket writes

the _resolve_conflicted_pop function must not assume that conflicted paths are reconciler-regenerable; foreign source paths (not tracked on origin/tickets) must be classified and discarded rather than causing store writes to wedge
a supported maintenance entrypoint must exist to allow safe raw-git operations on the tracker with backup-before-first-write semantics and a refusal guard when unpushed ticket commits are present
fsck must report when the tickets worktree contains tracked source paths that do not belong on origin/tickets, since silent healing prevents detection of pollution
the tracker should be operated as a standalone clone rather than a linked worktree to eliminate the shared stash stack hazard entirely
